chunks: We gave the Children of Israel a settled abode, and provided them with good things. So they did not differ until knowledge came to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding that over which they used to differ.
ai.seo_question: What caused the Children of Israel to differ according to Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'secure dwelling' (mubawwa'a sidq) is often interpreted as the land of Palestine or specifically the spiritual station of the Ahl al-Bayt, while the 'knowledge' that caused division is frequently identified as the Quran or the specific teachings of the Imams. This verse highlights the principle that divine guidance, when properly understood, unifies, but when contested or misinterpreted, leads to sectarian fragmentation, a theme central to Shia historical consciousness. Consequently, the final judgment will resolve these theological and jurisprudential disputes, affirming the truth of the divinely appointed leadership.
